description: Read by scripts/test-env.mjs at run time. The command run by `node scripts/test-env.mjs run` starts from an EMPTY environment: only the names in `inherit` pass through from the caller, then the env file and the pins are added. docs/LOCAL_TESTING.md justifies every name and path here. Database inputs, loader inputs (DOTENV_*, NODE_OPTIONS, npm_config_*, JITI_*, TSX_*) and NODE_ENV are refused in `inherit`.
